name: Decision
purpose: One question that splits into two paths: if yes, do this; if no, do that.
use_when: the source gives a rule with a condition (if / when / unless)
a judgment call with two clear outcomes
avoid_when: more than two outcomes (use comparison or card_grid)
steps in a fixed order (use numbered_steps)

question.desc: The decision point, as a question

text.desc: What to do on this path

tree.desc: The question on top, branching down into two outcome cards

stacked.desc: The question, then each path as a labeled row with an arrow

yes.label: Yes
yes.text: Get your manager's approval before you buy.

no.label: No
no.text: Buy it and submit the receipt within a week.

example_beats.say: Before you buy anything for work, ask one question: is it over five hundred dollars?
If it is, get your manager's approval first.
If not, just buy it and submit the receipt within a week.
